name: Find Pervet
steps: Tap teddy bear to reveal hidden spy.
Tap under bed to find spy hiding there.
Tap wall painting to expose camera spy.
Tap wall shadow to reveal hidden spy.
Tap chandelier to catch hanging spy.
Tap sofa back to pull out spy.
Tap wardrobe doors to find spies inside.
Tap door crack to catch peeking spy.
Tap wall poster to reveal secret cubby spy.
Tap ceiling vent to catch final spy.
